newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close slightly up on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close slightly up on Wall Street.

text.p: Italian shares finished on an upward trend at the day's highs on Thursday after an early bout of profit-taking ran quickly out of steam and further strengthening on Wall Street provided psychological support to the market.
The all-share Mibtel index finished 0.27 percent higher at 10,062 with the blue chip Mib30 index closing 0.25 percent higher at 15,149.
A strong showing by carmaker Fiat and agri-chemicals group Montedison also helped carry the rest of the market upwards.
Fiat ordinary stock rose 2.56 percent to close at 4,519 lire as the rally in the car company, whose shares had climbed 10 percent in the previous two trading days, showed no sign of abating.

Talk that the government might introduce a program of incentives to boost Italy's flagging car market fuelled the buying although market commentators said they were unsure whether Italy would follow France's lead in adopting such a plan.
Volumes totalled 661 billion lire ($434 million), down from 896 billion lire on Wednesday. $=1,516 lire
